title: MSA/DPA concession routing + preflight checklist for enterprise pricing experiments
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Define and implement a repeatable preflight checklist and automated routing flow for MSA/DPA redlines that arise during pricing and packaging experiments. Scope includes: risk-tagging rules, concession thresholds (liability cap, indemnity scope, data residency clauses), mandatory security questionnaire triggers, and automation hooks for Legal/Sales Ops review. Goal: reduce cycle time for low-risk concessions to <3 business days while ensuring high-risk changes are escalated to Legal with context.

Objectives: 
- Create a deterministic set of rules that map redline items to risk buckets (low/medium/high) and to routing targets (self-service, Sales Ops, Legal SME, Security team).
- Define concession thresholds tied to ARR impact and contract term (e.g., sales rep authorization limits vs. Director approval).
- Build a preflight checklist that Sales attaches before submitting any MSA/DPA redline: pricing impact calc, data classification, requested indemnity language, requested liability cap, required DPA addenda.
- Integrate with existing tools: Zendesk intake form for contract edits, Confluence templates, and the contract-templates GitHub repo for managed template changes.
- Tie experiment-specific guardrails: experiments that change unit pricing or packaging must include finance sign-off and a fallback pricing SKU.

Scope exclusions: Enterprise legal strategy refresh or wholesale template rewrites (tracked in PM-5110) are out of scope. This ticket focuses on routing, checklist and automation for redlines tied to pricing experiments and security questionnaires.

Acceptance criteria (high level): 
- A published preflight checklist doc in Confluence with step-by-step guidance for Sales and Solutions Engineering.
- A rule table that maps common redline types to risk levels and routing destinations (published as a Google Sheet).
- A working Zendesk intake form (or equivalent) that enforces checklist completeness before a redline is routed.
- A Slack notification + Legal triage channel integration that summarizes redline context, risk tags, and links to artifacts.
- Measured reduction in median review time for low-risk redlines from ~7 days to <=3 days in pilot region.
comments: 2025-11-09 - Aisha Patel: Initial scope drafted after workshop with Sales Ops and Legal. Highlights: need faster gating for pricing experiments and clearer DPA triggers for private deployments.

2025-11-11 - Marcel Nguyen (Legal): Reviewed draft risk buckets. Feedback: cap on liability should default to fees for the covered term; indemnity carve-outs for third-party data processors must be explicit. Will provide template guidance by 2025-11-18.

2025-11-13 - Priya Shah (Sales Ops): Requests that we include dollar thresholds by ARR uplift (e.g., concessions that reduce ARR by >$100k require Director approval). Also asked for a faster path for renewals under standard terms.

2025-11-15 - Engineering (ENG-4123) scoping note: We can add an intake endpoint that surfaces the redline metadata to the contract-templates repo CI. Estimated 3 dev days for initial integration and a follow-up for automation.

2025-11-18 - Security (Janet Li): Security questionnaire should be mandatory when customer requests private deployment, cross-border data residency changes, or connector-level access to customer systems. We'll attach the baseline SQ document link.
2025-11-20 - Liam O'Connor: Consolidated checklist and updated routing rules. Next: build Zendesk intake and Confluence doc. Preparing pilot with EMEA sales team week of 2025-11-24.
acceptance_criteria: Confluence preflight checklist published and linked in Sales playbook
Zendesk intake enforces required fields and prevents submission when mandatory SQ attachments are missing
Routing rules document maps >=20 common redline patterns to risk buckets and responsible parties
Pilot metric: median review time for low-risk redlines <=3 business days across pilot sales reps
Automated Slack summary posted for every routed redline with links to artifacts and initial risk tag
